answer: Cluster-capped rewards: the ledger embeds each agent's answers and timing, then groups identities whose outputs are suspiciously alike. A cluster shares one reward cap, so a farm of clones splits a single payout instead of multiplying it. Spinning up fakes that look independent means writing truly distinct work each epoch, like carving a new basalt fable rather than copying one; the attacker's profit hits its nadir at roughly one honest agent's worth.
